rationale: L_conc needs i.i.d. calibration/test data; stated (Thm 1) but only satisfied by construction on synthetic data, no evidence for it.
Coverage confirmed by testing on physical imbq_quito NISQ hardware (real device noise), stronger than simulator runs.
Guarantee is probabilistic (w.p. 1-eps_bar), not a sound certificate on the model; evaluated only in unicycle robot simulation.
Learned part is the NN load forecaster; downstream QP is not learned. Predictors count as estimation (cf. COMP-1).
VHAGaR supports L-inf plus six perturbations the paper calls semantic features; running headline examples are occlusion/brightness feature perturbations.
Coverage shown only on benchmark datasets (MNIST-DVS, DVS128 Gesture, CIFAR-10); codebook: benchmark environment is simulated.
